result.summary: Verdict FINDINGS at target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895 (feature/binary-config-serve-20260930); read-only in a detached /tmp clone, HEAD verified. Scope: restart recovery, interrupted dispatch/provisioning/control intents, stale sessions, stranded workers. No CRITICAL/HIGH. MEDIUM src/coordinator.ts:831 - recovery_required is terminal and unresumable even when the coordinator parked the worker on a paused/stopped/healthy guest: resume is refused, the terminal early return at :420 precedes the paused/stopped mapping at :421-432, and the tick skips terminal states at :344-349. The emitted 'inspect before resuming' error names a step no tool performs; the only recovery (send_worker_message) cancels the original dispatch, so the spawned prompt is never re-delivered. Reproduced for interrupted submit, stopped guest and quiesce-paused guest across restarts. LOW src/coordinator.ts:685 - result.json fallback requires the optional run_id, discarding a schema-valid file result. Intent replay, VM adoption/orphan retention, vm_missing and shutdown paths are sound. Artifacts: .swarmforge/artifacts/review.md, findings.json.
result.details:
Setup: official Bun 1.4.2 unpacked in /tmp (snapshot bun 1.3.14 cannot read this lockfileVersion 2 lockfile); bun install --frozen-lockfile in a disposable lab copy, lockfile not rewritten. /workspace/repo stayed at baseline 5672ead, clean and unmodified.

F1 MEDIUM (reproduced): recovery_required is in terminal (src/domain.ts:17-23) so runTick skips it (src/coordinator.ts:344-349) and runRecover returns at :420 before mapping a paused/stopped guest (:421-432, where the !terminal.has guard at :429 is dead code); control 'resume' is gated on state==='paused' (:830-831). Entry paths: interrupted submit -> 'Prompt delivery ambiguous' on a running idle guest (:561-579); stopped guest -> 'VM stopped; inspect before resuming' (:429-432); quiesce that could only pause the guest -> recovery_required (:785-804, :909-926). applyControl can already resume such a guest (:859, :915-916) but is unreachable. Retained VMs keep consuming SWARMFORGE_MAX_WORKERS capacity (:317-322, probe P4). Probes: p1 P1 (stopped guest, resume refused, unchanged after a second restart), p1 P2 (paused guest, resume refused after restart), p2 P5 (dispatch 'sending' + idle session -> recovery_required on a running guest), p3 P8 (send_worker_message recovers but runs become ['cancelled:Implement a feature','sent:please continue'], so the spawned prompt is never re-delivered). Existing tests only assert entry into the state (tests/lifecycle.test.ts:144,179,264,352); docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:16 documents follow-ups as the resolution, so this is an operability gap versus the messages the code emits.

F2 LOW (reproduced): fallback() rejects a schema-valid result file lacking the optional run_id (src/coordinator.ts:685 vs src/domain.ts:45), while identify() overwrites run_id anyway (:665-672); probe p3 P7 shows the worker left waiting with no result vs completed when run_id is present. Documented as 'a matching-run result.json' (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:26).

Checked and sound: durable pause/cancel/destroy intents replay after restart (p1 P3); VM adoption by metadata and visible orphan retention (coordinator:365-396, lifecycle:179); confirmed-absent VM -> failed + vm_missing, never re-provisioned (coordinator:408-419); a landed prompt is marked sent, not replayed (coordinator:561-567, lifecycle:250); durable token-progress baseline survives restart (store:265-276); startup order, rollback, abort-during-recovery, listener release, process lock and event-log cursor (serve.ts:140-198, serve-command.ts:88-137, runtime.ts:145-213; tests/serve.test.ts:331,354,380,432); track/stop writer drain and waitForStateChange wake on shutdown (coordinator:82-90, 258-300).
